points.text: Donald Trump announced that Stephen Miller will replace Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff.
A federal judge temporarily halted construction of Trump’s planned Washington arch, which also faces legal challenges.
OpenAI introduced a cybersecurity-focused model and said it identified 81 high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities and developed working exploits for 948 Linux kernel bugs.
A Kenyan court sentenced Paul Mackenzie to 200 years in prison for murders linked to starvation at his cult.
Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigned amid a political crisis linked to Ueno bank’s collapse; parliamentary approval is pending.
